title: Geometric theory of generalised continua using moving frames
summary: Generalised continuum theories couple the macroscopic deformation and the micro-/meso-scopic deformation of an underlying micro-structure. They can account for internal length-scale effects and higher-order mechanical loadings absent from classical Cauchy elasticity and has shown its efficiency in modelling metamaterials.
